purpose: Exercise the P031 Seal profile panel and full-draft authority in pinned UZDoom
notes: The Seal panel is the player-usable pre-run path; capacity is supplied by the explicit profile/unlock input and defaults to zero.
The only ordinary selectable content is the qualified WHIP, POWER and ARMOR subset; an optional fourth candidate is labelled test-only.
This chamber proves menu and inventory authority behavior; it is not a replacement for MAP16 concurrent-arsenal evidence.
